B40.family: Б L.H.40 I-beams (ТОВ «Мост Строй Комплект», Dnipro), after «Альбом збірних залізобетонних балок довжиною 12, 15, 18, 21, 24, 33 м двотаврового перерізу...», ДП «ДерждорНДІ», 2012
B40.designation_rule: Б L.H.W: L = length cm, H = depth cm, W = top-flange width cm; suffix П/К = intermediate/edge beam (same concrete outline)

transcribed_common_mm.details: Вузол А: R40 at top flange/haunch, R50 at haunch/web, 129 deg; Вузол Б: R40 at both bottom haunch corners, 129 deg (drawn on pp48, 51, 54, 57, 60)

B40.published_capacity_note: Only ULS bending/shear resistance per beam is published (e.g. Б1200.100.40: 2930 kNm / 1270 kN with 250 mm slab, 1905 kNm / 1098 kN bare; Б1500.100.40: 3850 / 1380 and 2200 / 1080). No area, mass or volume.
geometry_notes: Modelled with sharp vertices at the facade-chain levels (150, 240 from top; H-925 and H-795 from soffit) and tangent circular fillets R40/R50/R40/R40; the resulting tangent points reproduce every value of the section chain (131/31/63/39/512/31/106/31/f/20) within 0.5 mm, so both chains are honoured.
The drawings print the haunch included angle as 129 deg; the width/level chain gives 129.3 deg (top) and 129.1 deg (bottom) -- the width/level chain is used.

The 1000 mm deep drawings (pp45, 48) print 95 as the lowest facade chain value, so that chain sums to 1020; the section chain (20+36+R40 tangent) and the 1100 mm drawings (175 = 20+136+19) show it should be 75. 75 is used (drawing error recorded, not a convention).
Pp45 (12 m) shows no detail view; the fillet radii are taken from the identical outline on pp48-60 (Вузол Б on every sheet, Вузол А on p60).
Cross-sections depend on depth only: 12 m and 15 m share the 1000 mm section, 18/21/24 m the 1100 mm section; 33 m is 1200 mm. Only the bottom-flange vertical (36/136/236) changes.

3Bet.family: 3Bet-90 / 3Bet-120 I-beams (ЖБІ комбінат «3 Бетони», Kalush), approved by Ukravtodor Technical Council protocol No. 5 (06.08.2008)
3Bet.identity_check: The 3betony leaflet sketches give 3Bet-90 top 560/420, bottom 520, H 900 and 3Bet-120 top 700/610, bottom 580, H 1200 -- identical to the NIDI drawings, so each type is implemented once from the NIDI dimensions and validated against the leaflet volumes.

transcribed_mm.widths: top 420 (upstand, 10 draft each side to 440 at its base) / 560 at ledge / 540 at flange-haunch corner / web 200-160-200 / 520 at bottom-flange top / 500 at 10 mm above soffit / 480 soffit

geometry_notes: Web tapers 200 (at both haunches) to 160 at mid-depth (y = 450, the 190/190 chain point); the 20 offsets in the 160|20|160|20|160 chain are this taper.
Top flange: 60 mm ledge falls 15 mm outward (15 in the chain) from the 440 upstand base to the 560 edge; flange edge drafts 10 mm per side over 115 mm (560 -> 540).
Bottom flange drafts from 520 at y = 170 to 500 at y = 10, then a 10 x 10 chamfer to the 480 soffit. All corners sharp (no radii drawn).

transcribed_mm.widths: top 610 (5 draft each side), 680 (R10 tangent points on ledge), 700 overall; web 180 below the top fillet, 150 minimum, 180 above bottom haunch; bottom 580
transcribed_mm.radii: R10 ledge/edge, R25 edge/underside, R50 underside/web (both sides)
transcribed_mm.centre_chains: 185|275|185 = 645 between R25 and R50 centres; 215 from edge to R50 centre

geometry_notes: Sharp vertices: flange-underside outer vertex at 1095 (section chain 105 from top), web vertex at 1060 (chain 35; facade 1060). Facade gives 1100 for the outer line; 5 mm difference unresolved.

Web stations are a convention: 180 at the top-flange vertex tapering to 150 at y = 730 (the 330/330 chain point) and back to 180 at y = 530, parallel 180 down to the haunch at y = 400. The printed 150/180 dimension levels (~y 610-640 and ~y 520-550) were scaled from the drawing (0.3 px/mm); a pixel trace of both 3Bet-120 sheets gives half-widths ~82 (y 900-1030), ~75-79 (y 640-860), ~82 (y 540-620), ~90 (y 400-520).
Upstand 20 high with 5 draft each side (610 -> 620); ledge 40 wide, level, R10 at its outer corner (680 = R10 tangent points); flange edge vertical at 700.
The '5' next to each 215 dimension and the right-hand 45/5 chain could not be resolved; the 215/185/275/645 centre chains agree with the adopted outline within ~8 mm.
Area exceeds the leaflet volume/length by about 1.3% (pinned in tests); the likely source is the web taper stations or a 5 mm outer-edge draft, both below the resolution of the drawing.

volume_regression.note: V/L is essentially constant per type (no end blocks); the intercepts are ~ -0.01/-0.03 m3, i.e. actual lengths marginally under nominal.

BM.family: БМ-24 / БМ-33 bridge I-beams (Kovalska / Darnytsia ZBK) = Oberbeton parametric bridge beam (same 600/480/160/320/313 chain)

transcribed_mm.kovalska_p30: Рис.1 H 1100, Рис.2 H 1500; top 600; top zone 320; web 160; bottom zone 313; bottom 480; length up to 33000. БМ-24/БМ-33 named on p31.
transcribed_mm.oberbeton: H 1100-1500; top 600 = 60|480|60; upstand 40; 5; flange edge 55; top haunch 220 at 1:1; web 160, length 467-867; bottom haunch 160 at 1:1; bottom flange 153; soffit 480 with 20x20 chamfers; R100 at both web/haunch junctions.

geometry_notes: Kovalska names two discrete sizes (H 1100 = БМ-24, H 1500 = БМ-33); Oberbeton gives only the continuous range 1100-1500 whose end points coincide. Only these two named depths are implemented; no intermediate step convention is used.
The Kovalska vector sketch is schematic (the 320 and 313 zones are drawn equal length and БМ-33 is БМ-24 with a stretched web), so detail geometry is taken from the dimensioned Oberbeton section 1-1.
Convention: the '5' under the 40 mm upstand is modelled as a ledge falling 5 mm over its 60 mm width to the flange edge (40 + 5 + 55 + 220 = 320).
Flange-edge/haunch corners are sharp (no radius drawn); R100 tangent fillets at the two web/haunch corners as drawn.
No area, mass or volume is published by either producer.
